Product Features

  • Cloud-shaped design: Exceptional cloud-shaped coffee table with a length of 107 cm and a width of 66 cm.
  • MDF table top: Smooth, lacquered surface for an elegant look and pleasant feel.
  • Sturdy PVC legs: Three sturdy, cylindrical table legs provide a modern and stable construction.
  • Felt underlays: Protects the floor from scratches and makes it easier to move the table.
  • Lightweight Design: Despite its sturdy construction, the table is lightweight and easy to move.
  • Easy-care surface: The lacquered surface is easy to clean and remains free of fingerprints.
  • Versatile: Ideal for modern living rooms or as stylish accent furniture in different rooms.

Descriptions

This unique cloud-shaped coffee table is a true highlight for any modern living room. With a maximum length of 107 cm and a width of 66 cm, it offers enough space for decorative items, books or drinks, adding a playful and elegant touch to your space. The tabletop is made of high-quality MDF, which is covered with a smooth and fine lacquer. This not only ensures a flawless look, but also feels particularly pleasant - no rough surfaces or residues on the hand after touching. The tabletop is supported by three robust, cylindrical table legs made of PVC, which are also lacquered to underline the modern design. There are felt pads at the bottom of the table that protect your floor from scratches and allow the table to be easily moved. Despite its sturdy construction, the table is very light and can be moved effortlessly, allowing it to be used flexibly in different areas of the home. Combining style, lightness and functionality, this coffee table is perfect for those looking for an exceptional piece of furniture that can be harmoniously integrated into different living concepts. The elegant cloud shape and the high-quality lacquer finish make this table a real eye-catcher in any room.
